models_evaluated: LLM with Clinical Entity Augmented Retrieval (CLEAR) combined with rule-based logic

links.outcome: LLM sensitivity and specificity for CAUTI classification on local historical cases versus infection preventionist gold standard
links.effect: Combined rule-based logic plus CLEAR-LLM achieved sensitivity 90.0% and specificity 93.5% on 919 local flagged cases; after adjudication 93.6% and 98.6%.
links.quote: Combining rule-based logic with Clinical Entity Augmented Retrieval (CLEAR) input into an LLM achieved the highest sensitivity (90.0%) and specificity (93.5%).

unlisted_practices: Combining LLM with rule-based algorithm for infection surveillance case classification
Clinical entity augmented retrieval to structure EMR inputs for LLM

screen.reason: Evaluates combining rule-based surveillance with LLM-based entity retrieval to improve infection surveillance efficiency and accuracy compared to standard approaches.

primary.practice: combining rule-based logic with retrieval-augmented LLM
